name: session-info
description: Claude Code footer with the project, git branch, model and context usage.

accentColor.title: Accent color
accentColor.description: Color of the project name and of the context bar below 75%.

position.title: Position
position.description: Where it shows: above (the band above the prompt), footer (right of the line under the prompt) or hint (after the hints under the prompt).

showProject.title: Show the project
showProject.description: The name of the session's project folder.

showBranch.title: Show the git branch
showBranch.description: The current branch, or the short commit on a detached HEAD.

showModel.title: Show the model
showModel.description: The model the session is using, as /model shows it.

showContext.title: Show the context usage
showContext.description: The percentage of the context window in use.
